title: Bible Guide
heading: How well do you know the Bible?
paragraph: For more than four hundred years, churches have taught the faith by asking questions. Parents put them to their children at home, Sunday school teachers to their classes, pastors to those about to join the church. Here they are gathered in one place, from the Heidelberg Catechism of 1563 to Bible quizzes written this year, each with the answer its source printed and many tied to the verse they ask about.

blocks.text: How well do you know the Bible?

For more than four hundred years, churches have taught the faith by asking questions. Parents put them to their children at home, Sunday school teachers to their classes, pastors to those about to join the church. Here they are gathered in one place, from the Heidelberg Catechism of 1563 to Bible quizzes written this year, each with the answer its source printed and many tied to the verse they ask about.
Confessed The catechisms of the churches, since 1563
Taught Sunday school lessons for children, 1903
Tested Bible quizzes, old and new
each opens the passage it asks about
Every book of the Bible with the questions tied to it, by their reference or by naming it. The deeper the colour and the longer the spoke, the more questions. Choose a book to see its questions.
Questions gathered by what they are about, the same themes as the test page. Choose a shelf, then a group, then a theme.
